title: Connecting Voices
short_description: Together we open and close a space where we can explore our voices with singing in circle. Every moment I tune into what rainbow or medicine song wants to be played next and the group co-creates this journey of melody sea. 🌊
description:
Every Tuesday is the moment to come together to explore our own voice and those of each other. 🌬️

Listen, call & respond to the voices around you. 🌀 Be part of the magic when melodies meet and emerge into moments of sounding presence.

The water is supporting our process during connecting voices, sometimes she is present on the altar and other times we sing songs of the waters. 💙

🛕 Be welcome with your voice and ears in our beautiful Shala in Essência.

I wish to receive a money exchange between €8-20,- to continue to singing from my heart. 🫶🏼

Sing you soon
Birdy
🙏🏽

Ps. Money shouldn’t be a reason not to come, please reach out to me in a private message, if you wish an alternative exchange.
